hints.tr: Alıcı: `@property` ve altında `def house(self): return self._house`. Ayarlayıcı: `@house.setter` ve altında `def house(self, house):`, önce denetim, sonra `self._house = house`.
hints.en: Getter: `@property` and below it `def house(self): return self._house`. Setter: `@house.setter` and below it `def house(self, house):`, the check first, then `self._house = house`.
